tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kyi rim pa bzhugs so// 1$0000300oṃ āḥhūm̐/ nub phyogs bde ba chen po'i zhing khams kyi// padma stong ldan 'od kyi gzhal yas su// mgon po tshe dpag med la gsol ba 'debs// 'chi med tshe dbang thob par byin gyis rlobs// chos dbyings rnam par dag pa'i zhing khams su// 'od gsal lhun gyis grub pa'i pho brang du// tshe bdag rgyal ba rigs lnga la gsol ba 'debs// 'gyur med sku lnga thob par byin gyis rlobs// shar phyogs ri bo ta la'i gnas mchog tu// rang byung 'gyur ba med pa'i gzhal yas su// mgon po spyan ras gzigs la gsol ba 'debs// skye 'chi 'gyur med thob par byin gyis rlobs// rnga yab zangs mdog dpal ri'i gnas mchog tu// pho brang padma 'od kyi gzhal yas su// rig 'dzin padma thod phreng la= tshe yi rig 'dzin thob par byin gyis rlobs// bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag gi /sgrub gnas ārya pa lo'i gnas mchog tu// grub chen rje 'bangs grogs lnga la= tshe sgrub mtha' ru phyin par byin gyis rlobs// rgyal khams phyogs med gnas kyi dam pa ru// snang ba rang sar grol ba'i pho brang du// chos rgyal ratna gling pa la= thugs rgyud byin rlabs 'pho bar byin gyis rlobs// spyi gtsug nyi zla padma'i gdan steng du// drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma la= 'gro don phyogs med 'byung bar byin gyis rlobs// rang lus rtsa khams dag pa'i dkyil 'khor du// yi dam zhi khro'i lha tshogs la gsol ba 'debs// phung po lhag med 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// bka' gsang dam tshig gnyan po'i pho brang nas// bka' srung mkha' 'gro chos skyong la= sangs rgyas bstan pa dar bar byin gyis rlobs// phyogs med snang ba dag pa'i zhing khams su// mched grogs chos mdzad rnams la= dag snang phyogs med 'byongs bar byin gyis rlobs// bka' drin can gyi bka' brgyud bla ma rnams// rab gus gdung ba chen pos gsol ba 'debs// skal ldan bdag la dbang skur byin rlobs la// byang chub sgrub la bar chad mi 'byung zhing*// sngon las 'phral rkyen tshe la gnod pa yi// nad gdon bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*// tshe dang sgrub pa mtha' ru phyin pa ru// thugs rje ldan pa rnams kyi byin gyis rlobs// bla ma sku khams bzang bar byin gyis rlobs// mchog tu sku tshe ring bar byin gyis rlobs// phrin las dar zhing rgyas par byin gyis rlobs// bla ma dang 'du 'bral med par byin gyis rlobs//

tshe khrid rdo rje'i phreng ba'i gsol 'debs 'di/ rje 'bangs grogs lnga yan ni shog ser las yin zhing*/ 'og ma rnams cung zad bskyed pa 'di/ me pho stag gi lo la dwangs spro bsam gtan gling du ratna gling pas yi ger bkod pa'o// //
